title: AuthContext 401 handler clears localStorage unconditionally: a late 401 for tab-1's old key deletes the replacement key another tab stored (cross-tab half of the late-401 gap that e31065a closed only in client.ts)
evidence: apps/web/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx:140-146 (handleAuthInvalidated, introduced by dd6a3b2) matches on React state (detail.apiKey === apiKey at :144) and then calls clearApiKey(), whose localStorage.removeItem at :34-35 has no stored===failed-key guard. apps/web/src/api/client.ts:42-48 (e31065a) guards storage correctly, but the handler's clearApiKey defeats it. Server returns 401 for invalid or revoked keys (apps/api auth middleware), so the trigger is legitimate. Loss is session availability (the replacement key is deleted and that tab is logged out on next load), not disclosure. Existing tests (client.test.ts:54, :76) exercise only invalidateAuth, not the AuthContext handler path.
reproduction: 1. Tab 1: paste key A (state=A, storage=A) and open a page whose request is in flight or will be retried. 2. Tab 2 (same origin): clear and paste key B (storage=B); tab 1 state is still A (no storage listener). 3. In tab 1 trigger any apiFetch; the server answers 401 for A (revoked). 4. client.ts invalidateAuth sees stored=B != A and leaves storage alone, then dispatches lkb:auth-invalidated {apiKey:A}. 5. AuthContext handler: detail.apiKey (A) === apiKey (A), so clearApiKey() runs and removes lkbApiKey (B) from localStorage. Expected: localStorage still B. Actual: null; tab 2 is logged out on reload. Failing assertion: after step 5, expect(localStorage.getItem('lkbApiKey')).toBe('B').
fix_direction: In AuthContext, make the handler clear storage only when storage is null or equals detail.apiKey (mirror client.ts:46) and always reset React state; or add a window 'storage' listener so state follows storage. Add an AuthContext-level test with storage changed behind state.
verified_evidence: qa/verdicts/web-auth-key-clear-and-href-scheme.md (PASS cycle 1, source scope): recorded reproduction (A in state, B stored, 401 for A through real apiFetch, expect storage B) 1/1 in AuthContext.test.tsx. D-024 browser check STILL OWED
